title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce Senior Software Engineer with hands-on experience in Salesforce platform development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform using modern Salesforce technologies. 
 The role requires strong expertise in Apex programming, Lightning Web Components (LWC), integrations, and Salesforce platform customization. The candidate will work closely with business analysts, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring adherence to Salesforce development best practices, security standards, and performance optimization. 
 In an AI-enabled delivery environment, the candidate is expected to leverage AI tools in daily development activities to drive efficiency, quality, and faster delivery. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, and Visualforce. Implement custom business logic using Apex classes, triggers, batch Apex, queueable Apex, and scheduled jobs. Develop and customize Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, validation rules, record types, page layouts, and Lightning App Builder components. Build modern user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce Lightning Experience. Implement integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, External Services, and Platform Events. Develop asynchronous and event-driven solutions using Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Streaming API where applicable. Design and implement secure and scalable integrations using OAuth, connected apps, and API-based authentication mechanisms. Perform code reviews, debugging, and optimization to ensure high-quality and maintainable code. Write and maintain unit tests and achieve required Apex test coverage in accordance with Salesforce deployment requirements. Manage version control and CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Git, Salesforce DX (SFDX), and DevOps tools. Participate in technical design discussions, sprint planning, and agile development ceremonies. Collaborate with functional teams to analyze requirements and propose optimal Salesforce-based solutions. Ensure adherence to Salesforce governor limits, platform security, and performance best practices. Leverage AI tools in daily development activities to drive efficiency, quality, and faster delivery. 
 Must Have Minimum 3 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (SFDC). Salesforce Certified Platform Developer certification. Strong experience in Apex programming, triggers, and asynchronous Apex (Batch, Queueable, Future methods). Hands-on experience developing Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working with Lightning Experience. Experience building REST/SOAP integrations with external systems. Solid understanding of Salesforce data model, relationships, and security model (Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing Rules, Role Hierarchy). Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX), metadata deployment, and version control systems such as Git. Experience working with Salesforce APIs including REST API, Bulk API, and Metadata API. Experience with Salesforce Flow (Record-Triggered Flow, Scheduled Flow, Screen Flow) for automation. Strong knowledge of Salesforce governor limits, performance optimization, and debugging techniques. Experience writing Apex unit tests and ensuring high code coverage. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Hands-on experience in AI prompt writing and effective use of AI tools to drive productivity improvement. 
 Good to Have Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) development. Knowledge of Salesforce DevOps tools such as Copado. Exposure to Salesforce integrations using MuleSoft or middleware platforms. Understanding of Salesforce Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Event-driven architecture. Exposure to Salesforce Industries or Salesforce CPQ implementations. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices for Salesforce applications. Experience working with large-scale Salesforce implementations or enterprise CRM ecosystems. Knowledge of test automation frameworks for Salesforce.

description:

Join us and help run what runs the world. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion 

 Location This role is open globally, but location is set in China (Beijing), Finland (Helsinki), India (Bangalore) and US (New Berlin). The work model is on-site #LI-onsite. 

 Key Responsibilities In this role, you will lead the global sourcing strategy for Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), managing key supplier relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving cost optimization initiatives. You will play a critical role in ensuring a high-performing, sustainable, and resilient supplier base while supporting business growth, mitigating supply chain risks, and delivering against financial and operational targets on a global scale. 
 This position reports to the Global SCM Manager, Motion Drive Products. 

 In this role you will be accountable for: Leverage the Continuous Improvement Process Sourcing (CIPS) process for planning and implementing EMS effective sourcing strategies in line with business strategy and ensuring that the supply base/suppliers have the capability and capacity to meet current and future business requirements. Manage planning and tracking of procurement activities, cost budgets, emerging country spending, and savings forecasts. Minimize risk regarding quality and financial exposure by buying in accordance with quality and commercial procedures and group/ business area guidelines. Negotiate agreements with main suppliers, and periodically renew price lists, and terms and conditions. Ensure identification, investigation and selection of appropriate suppliers (focusing on quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability) in accordance with company policies, drives the collaboration with Supplier relationship management (SRM) as Supplier account Manager (SAM) for selected global EMS partners Define and establish local and global standard agreements with all major suppliers. Plan and support the implementation of cost-out programs and/or processes to reach financial targets. Contribute to and participate in setting and implementing budgets and targets within the group of global categories, and ensures the EMS category sourcing performance targets are achieved. 

 Qualifications Bachelor's or higher degree in Engineering or in a related field.  10+ years of experience in procurement or supply chain management with strong understanding of EMS manufacturing processes. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and networking skills. Fluency in English, with other languages being a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Excellent business acumen and build effective Supplier Relationship Management Strong technical, commercial, and interpersonal skills. Ability to develop and execute long-term strategies. Previous experience in Budget & Performance Management. Willingness to travel. 

 What's in it for you? We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward. Contribute to a collective vision. This is where progress takes flight, teams turn ideas into impact, and we define what’s next. title: Brand Visualiser (Video Editing / Design / Motion)
description:
Design, Motion & Visual Communication Experience: 6-7+ Years Function: Brand / Marketing / Creative Company: DTDC Express Ltd. 
 About the Role 
 DTDC is looking for a Senior Brand Visualiser who can translate brand and communication objectives into compelling visual ideas and execute them across multiple formats. This is not a traditional graphic design or video-editing role. We are looking for a visual thinker and storyteller who understands how to build a visual narrative, develop a creative direction and communicate an idea through design, imagery, typography, motion and video. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable conceptualising a campaign, creating its visual language, designing the static assets and bringing the idea to life through motion and video. The role also requires strong hands-on knowledge of Generative AI and AI-powered creative workflows, including image generation, video generation, voice, avatars and prompt engineering. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Visualisation & Creative Conceptualisation Develop creative concepts and visual directions based on brand, marketing and communication objectives. Translate a brief or business problem into a strong visual idea or creative concept. Develop Key Visuals (KVs), campaign territories, moodboards, storyboards and visual narratives. Decide how an idea should be communicated visually across different platforms and formats. Think beyond individual creatives and build connected visual systems for campaigns. Develop visual storytelling through composition, typography, imagery, colour, illustration, motion and sequencing. Present and communicate creative concepts clearly to internal stakeholders and explain the thinking behind the visual direction. Ensure that creative ideas are both conceptually strong and relevant to the DTDC brand. Brand & Graphic Design Design high-quality creative assets across digital, social, print, internal communication and marketing platforms. Develop campaign KVs, social media creatives, digital banners, mailers, presentations, OOH creatives, internal communication and other brand collaterals. Maintain strong visual consistency and adherence to DTDC's brand identity. Have a strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, composition and visual communication. Adapt a single creative idea into multiple formats while retaining its core visual identity. Create designs that are not only aesthetically strong but also communicate the intended message clearly and quickly. 
 Video & Motion 
 Conceptualise and create videos, reels, motion graphics and short-form brand content. Translate static campaign ideas into motion and video narratives. Create storyboards, shot concepts and visual sequences before production. Edit and produce videos using professional video-editing and motion-graphics tools. Understand pacing, transitions, visual rhythm, sound and storytelling. Collaborate with internal teams, production partners, photographers, videographers and other creative stakeholders where required. 
 AI & Generative Creative 
 Use AI as an integral part of the creative process to improve ideation, experimentation, production and visual storytelling. Hands-on experience with tools such as: ChatGPT: ideation, creative development, research and prompt engineering Nano Banana: AI image generation and image manipulation Seedream: AI image generation Seedance: AI video generation and animation Runway: AI video generation and creative production Adobe Firefly: generative design and image creation ElevenLabs: AI voice generation and sound HeyGen: AI avatars and video generation Other emerging AI image, video, audio and creative tools The candidate should be able to evaluate different AI tools and determine which tool and workflow is appropriate for a particular creative requirement. 
 Software & Technical Skills Design Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Adobe InDesign Video Adobe Premiere Pro Adobe After Effects DaVinci Resolve AI / Creative Technology ChatGPT Nano Banana Seedream Seedance Runway Adobe Firefly ElevenLabs HeyGen Other emerging Generative AI platforms Knowledge of Blender / 3D would be an added advantage.
